concept: EventBridge: react to resource state-change events
tests: Choosing a service for event-driven automation on an AWS service event.
expected: An EventBridge rule on the EC2 Instance State-change event (stopped) → Lambda target. Triggers: "automatically run a Lambda whenever", "changes to the stopped state".
why_not: CloudWatch alarms react to metric thresholds, not discrete events; Config remediation fixes non-compliance; a subscription filter streams log content.
